pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Temporal_Reason: The pedestrian maintains a stationary standing posture across all 15 frames without any preparatory movements, weight shifts, or changes in stance that would indicate crossing intention, and their head remains oriented downward rather than scanning traffic.

pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Conclusion: The pedestrian will not cross the road because they are walking parallel to the street rather than toward it, showing no signs of crossing preparation, and are in an area without proper crossing infrastructure.
